content:
Instantly rejected immediately after completing the Welocalize Expert Rater – Italian assessment. Did I fail, or could this be an error?
I completed the assessment for the Welocalize/Welo Data **Expert Rater Project – Italian**. Immediately after submitting the final assessment section, the page changed to:

![img](wzkpunhwxtfh1)

“We’re sorry, you can’t continue. Based on your responses, we can’t offer you this opportunity.”

There was no waiting period or manual review, so it appears to have been an automatic decision.

Has anyone else received this immediately after finishing the assessment? Does it definitely mean the assessment score was below the required threshold, or can it happen because of a technical issue, project capacity, location verification, or another account-related condition?

Did anyone successfully contact support and receive clarification or another attempt?
